description: This file defines the Currency controller class in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages the display and updating of the currency selection in the storefront, including loading currency data, rendering the currency selection view, and processing currency change requests.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling currency display and update functionalities in the Opencart frontend.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares and renders the currency selection view, loading available currencies, current currency data, and constructing redirect URLs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the currency change request, updates session data, sets cookies, and provides JSON response for success or error states.
